Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: production website collectible monthly attendance badge, part of the four-badge “Legends of TREE” set.
Create exactly ONE isolated emblem, square 1:1, actual transparent background. A premium three-dimensional illustrated enamel collectible crest. Keep the same badge silhouette used across this set: a symmetrical rounded shield, broad horizontal top with two small scalloped shoulders, gently curved sides tapering into one rounded lower point; thick polished antique-gold beveled outer rim, fine inner gold inset, dark almost-black forest-green enamel field. Two compact embossed gold leaf sprigs hug the lower left and right rim. Badge occupies roughly 88% of square, upright front view with subtle depth but no tilt. Central character is raised relief projecting slightly beyond the inner field, readable at 100 pixels. Sophisticated game collectible art, clean bold shapes, beautiful soft upper-left key light, warm gold edge reflections. Keep little tiny detail and strong contrast. No scene, no floor, no background, no opaque square, no drop shadow beyond the emblem. No lettering, no words, no numerals, no banner, no ribbon, no logos with letters, no watermark. Subject should remain inside the outer crest overall with generous transparent margin. Preserve real alpha transparency.

The frame is warm copper-gold, inner accent enamel turquoise/cyan. Make it feel welcoming and wonderfully collectible, not infantile.
